title: The farthest pair need not be neighbours
hook: The farthest pair need not be neighbours. Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.

doesNotKnow: Find a convex polygon's diameter by advancing antipodal support pairs.

misconception: The longest polygon edge is always the diameter.
objective: Find a convex polygon's diameter by advancing antipodal support pairs.

claims.text: As a supporting polygon edge rotates, the opposite support vertex advances monotonically. Distances to these antipodal candidates expose the diameter without comparing every possible vertex pair.
